item.title: [7.9] 10-year US Treasury yields surges over 5.05% to 19-year high
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The average 30-year mortgage rate reached 7.12%, its highest since May 2024, marking a significant increase. This rise follows the recent Federal Reserve interest rate hike aimed at controlling inflation. As borrowing costs climb, refinancing and home purchase applications have decreased significantly.

WHY IT MATTERS

A breach of the 5.05% threshold on the 10-year Treasury to a 19-year high represents a major macroeconomic inflection point with direct transmission to consumer mortgage rates and broader asset valuations.
